# M4 — Documents core — module report (in progress)

## T-004 — Refunds via credit notes (BK-006 · OQ-012) — DONE 2026-10-28
**What was built.** A refund on an issued invoice is a credit note (avoir), never a payment reversal (OQ-012). The invoice detail offers "Établir un avoir" on paid and partially paid invoices; the amount is capped by a single tested rule, and the avoir is created as a draft that follows the normal credit lifecycle (send → apply to another invoice, or keep as client credit).

**Rule.** GIVEN an invoice WHEN a credit note is issued THEN the amount may not exceed: the amount actually received when the invoice is paid; the open balance when it is sent or partially paid; nothing at all for drafts and cancelled invoices. Over-ceiling requests are refused (409 AMOUNT_EXCEEDS_BALANCE); a non-positive amount is a validation error (422).

**Checks run.** 65/65 unit tests (4 new), typecheck and build clean. Live walk against the local Worker [EXECUTED]: paid invoice FAC-2026-0038 (28 450 XPF) → request 28 451 → 409; request 10 000 → 201, avoir AV-2026-0026 draft with balance 10 000 and one explanation line; request 0 → 422; activity journal shows `activity.credit_created_from_invoice`.

**Deviations.** The audit's original acceptance ("payment shows partially refunded") is not applicable under OQ-012 and was replaced by the credit-note ceiling rule above. Silent clamping was removed in favour of an explicit refusal (hiding a user error was a defect risk).

**Could not verify.** Browser-side rendering of the new modal (no browser in this environment); its data path is covered by the API walk.

## T-002b/c, T-005 (manual), T-007 — DONE 2026-10-28
Tax status is now a first-class line property in the editor, on the PDF ("Exonéré" instead of a rate, plus the legal paragraph when the document is exempt) and in the TVA report, which keeps the taxable base apart from the exempt base instead of lumping everything into a 0 % bucket. Overdue invoices offer a manual "Relancer" action that only records the reminder; the default terms no longer announce a late fee the app does not calculate. Quotes expose a computed expired flag shown as a chip on the list and the detail.
Checks: 65/65 tests, typecheck and build clean; live walk as recorded in the changelog. Gap found and reported, not fixed: ManaGest has no quote PDF at all, so the quote half of T-002b has no target.

**Still to do in M4.** Nothing in R1 except the platform-dependent automatic reminder (R2).


## T-108a — Quote and credit-note PDFs — DONE 2026-10-29
The audit had recorded these as present; they were not. A second builder now prints quotes (title DEVIS, validity date, quote terms) and credit notes (title AVOIR, status, positive total labelled « Total avoir ») with the invoice's typography, per-line TVA status and the company's legal mention. Download links sit on the quote detail and on every credit row.
Verified: 87/87 tests (3 new, including a 40-line pagination case), typecheck and build clean, and a live request per document type returning a real PDF (200, `%PDF`, ~2 KB), with an anonymous request refused (401).

## T-108 — second PDF layout + per-document choice (2026-10-29)
- **Built.** `server/services/pdf-style.ts` holds the only two layouts: `classic` (colour band, filled
  table header, accent total block) and `compact` (thin rules, accent text headers, plain bold total).
  Both the invoice builder and the quote/credit builder take a layout argument, defaulting to classic.
- **Choice.** Workspace default = `settings_extra.pdf_layout`, edited in Paramètres → Facturation
  (« Modèle de document PDF »), journalled, 422 on an unknown value. One document can use the other
  layout with `?layout=compact|classic` on `GET /invoices/:id/pdf`, `/quotes/:id/pdf`,
  `/credits/:id/pdf`. An unknown value falls back to the stored default, then to classic.
- **R-A / R-B / R-C.** The layout name is a setting, not a code constant; the settings screen shows the
  current choice read-only for a user without `settings.write`; changing it needs that permission
  server-side.
- **Tests.** 5 unit tests: request-over-default precedence, three fallback cases, style table, and both
  builders producing valid but different PDFs. Suite 99/99, typecheck and build clean.
- **Live walk [EXECUTED].** invoice classic 2 723 B / compact 2 706 B; quote and credit compact 200 with
  the `%PDF-` magic; `?layout=fancy` reproduces the classic file; switching the default to compact makes
  the plain URL return the compact file; invalid default 422; default restored to classic.
- **Not verified.** The rendered appearance of the compact layout could not be inspected visually
  (no browser in this environment); it is asserted by structure, not by eye.
